description: This file defines the WMLTag class, which reads and parses Wesnoth scenario files in WML format, extracting tags and settings from text files.

classes.name: WMLTag
classes.description: A class for parsing and representing WML tags from Wesnoth scenario files, including reading files, extracting tags, settings, and child tags.

methods.name: initWithFile
methods.description: Initializes a WMLTag object by loading a file and parsing its contents with a specific tag.

methods.name: initWithString
methods.description: Main initializer that parses a WML string, extracting tags and settings into internal structures.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Reads the next line from the WML text, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: childrenCount
methods.description: Returns the number of child tags.

methods.name: getChildAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the child WMLTag at the specified index.

methods.name: settingsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of settings (attributes) in the tag.

methods.name: getSettingFor
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a setting by key.
